build.command: docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 -w /src --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e CCACHE_DISABLE=1 -e GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 -e GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory -e GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0='*' --mount "type=bind,src=<PX4_ROOT>,dst=/src" px4io/px4-dev@sha256:4b727552a4f0dbf955721f031be555d2c1a4d8dfe931822381941bb86bf347c4 bash -c 'make px4_fmu-v6c_default'

GIT_CONFIG_* only marks the mounted tree safe for git inside the container; nothing is written to the tree's git config.
